summary: Max Payne is single-player. 7/7 launched XP boxes independently verified at the main menu, fullscreen at their GAMERES modes (frames + DISPLAYCFG re-read now). .124 BLOCKED (supervised-only D3D on vcr-kmd), .186 and .243 NA. Game closed on all 7.
issues: Graceful close (taskkill without /f) did not end MaxPayne.exe on .240: the WM_CLOSE taskkill.exe processes hung and an EXEC taskkill timed out at 40 s; lanparty kill printed 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' for .123 and .240. .240 was ended with PROCKILL of MaxPayne.exe and the two hung taskkill.exe; .123 closed on the retry.
After close, .133/.143/.171 report desktop 1280x1024 and .123 1280x1024@100 (their persisted desktop modes, not a stranded 640x480); .110 1600x1200, .184 1024x768, .240 1920x1080.
Main menu was the proof point; no level was loaded.
